$comment: A fixture, not an application. It exists so the rule that an application
command's exit code is NOT the harness's exit code can be exercised.
`test` exits 3. In the harness's own vocabulary 3 means did-not-run, and
gates.sh rendered this as `note tests did not run` and then exited 0 --
the suite blowing up read as a check that was never configured. 0/1/2/3
is a contract between the scripts in this repository; a third-party tool
shares only `0 means success`, and `tsc` really does exit 2 for type

app.test: echo 'the suite could not start' >&2; exit 3
